tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: All boundary cases checked. The target correctly separates the $n=0$ handling for norms, inner products, and rational‑$p$ norms (defined via empty sums) from the $n\ge1$ requirement for $d_\infty$ and all items that depend on a maximum over a nonempty index set. The rational‑exponent restriction is tied to the available power‑function definition, and the explicit $\mathbb{R}^1 \not\cong \mathbb{R}$ identification is consistently noted. No dimension miscount, index‑shift error, or hidden division by zero was found.

SOURCES: The complete current text of every deps‑listed item (31 items) was supplied and inspected; the target’s descriptions of their hypotheses, conclusions, and scope match those sources exactly.

CHECKED: The title, the full public statement, all six numbered sections, and the Remarks were read and verified against the cited items. No false claim, invalid inference, or material misrepresentation was detected.
